positioning: Affordable governed operating infrastructure for independent founders, creators, local operators, and small teams.
portfolio_moat: creator asset to portable rights-aware release package
consented first-party data to measured growth
market evidence to product lifecycle decision
shared organization customer consent asset evidence and attribution spine
non_goals: full accounting tax banking or payroll replacement
bulk messaging before consent deliverability suppression and provider controls
unrestricted identity imitation or autonomous publishing and spending
guaranteed revenue streams audience growth attribution or search placement

business_builder.primary_outcome: complete the first transaction and operate repeatably
priority_workflows: offer intake booking or order payment delivery review repeat follow-up
cash-flow and operating-health evidence without accounting claims

creator_studio.primary_outcome: turn original work into a portable rights-aware release or client package
priority_workflows: rights consent provenance originality and collaborator records
portable DAW distribution client and archive packages
brand partnership deliverables approvals disclosures and measurement

growth_studio.market: CRM lifecycle marketing and measurement operations
growth_studio.primary_outcome: turn consented first-party signals into measured customer growth
priority_workflows: shared consent ledger and customer timeline
touchpoints offline conversions deduplication and freshness
answer-engine visibility evidence without placement guarantees

pricing.policy: Keep the affordable ladder. Explicitly limit or separately price cost-bearing email SMS storage media generation support and third-party API work. Price changes require customer and cost-to-serve evidence plus owner approval.

evidence_rules: record source URL publisher observed date geography segment confidence and expiry
timestamp competitor price and capability observations
separate facts quotes estimates assumptions and opinions
never seed private workspaces with fictional customer or market evidence
link prioritized opportunities to Product Lifecycle initiatives
do not treat a large total addressable market as authorization to build
